purpose: Redesign the signal_queue.py dispatch pipeline to a deterministic, LIMIT-entry-first order lifecycle: every entry (grid, morning_glory, rebalance) is now a LIMIT order, never MARKET. Protective TP/SL orders are attached only after a confirmed exchange fill (full or partial), sized to whatever quantity is actually open rather than assumed. A resting, unfilled entry is cancelled once its entry_ttl_seconds elapses instead of being left to fill unexpectedly later. Adds an optional risk_pct position-sizing mode (alongside the existing notional_usd default), fixes a confirmed bug where submit_binance_testnet_intent silently dropped stop_loss/take_profit/limit_price from the tick-loop rebalance path, and records real live-testnet fills into a new paper_trading.live_fills table so PositionReconciler can see and repair real live positions instead of quarantining everything (its confidence gate previously had zero matching rows for any live trade). This scroll is a bootstrap artifact; do not treat it as a production seal.

execute: cd /home/idona/MoStar/scaffs/backend/agent && python -m pytest tests/test_signal_queue.py tests/test_signal_queue_dispatch.py tests/test_signal_queue_lifecycle.py -q

invariants: Every signal_queue.py dispatch order_type is LIMIT, never MARKET
Protective STOP_MARKET/TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET orders are only attached after a confirmed exchange fill (result.status FILLED, or reconcile_pending_entries detects executed_qty > 0) -- never before
closePosition=true protective orders correctly cover a partial fill without requiring an exact quantity match
A resting LIMIT entry whose entry_ttl_seconds has elapsed with zero fill is actively cancelled via client.cancel_order, not left resting indefinitely
risk_pct sizing is only applied when both risk_pct and criteria.stop_loss are present; stop_loss remains optional everywhere else and notional_usd sizing is unchanged when risk_pct is absent
submit_binance_testnet_intent forwards stop_loss/take_profit/limit_price from the incoming TradeIntent into criteria_vector instead of dropping them
PROTECTION_FAILED is retryable (no completed_at set) -- reconcile_pending_entries retries protection attachment on a subsequent pass rather than abandoning an unprotected position
ENTRY_CANCELLED_TTL is treated as retry-eligible by idim_feed_bridge.py (no live exposure remains), while DISPATCHED/PARTIALLY_FILLED/PROTECTED are not (real exposure exists)
Prior hardening (claim/CAS concurrency, fail-closed collision/leverage/margin checks, producer allowlist, batch-independent quality score) is unmodified by this scroll
